preserved_failures: final-audit-01: an inherited log marker retained the previous active host budget literal. The successor derives it from the stack-adjusted budget; no native rerun is needed.
cpu-precheck-01: the boxed error type was not Send across Rayon; convert the error to a String inside the broadcast closure.

cpu-execution-01: the fresh-process selector included the crate prefix and selected zero tests, and a cache fixture omitted stack reservation. Both fixtures are corrected and the child must report one executed test.
limitations: This bounds and reserves validated Rayon stack backing, not total thread/runtime RSS.
Main-thread and driver-created stacks, cached thread storage, allocator overhead, opaque driver/shared storage and remaining phase overlaps need separate accounting.
The local in-process adapter relies on its enclosing runtime to enforce the declared Rayon pool contract; Linux public-worker startup enforces it explicitly.
Sampled memory and thread counts are observations, not upper bounds. RSS and cgroup charged memory remain separate.
Ordinary workload admission still rejects incomplete lifetime profiles.
Broader/live-cache workload qualification, five matched throughput pairs, 24 hours AND 150 roots and all full-64/deadline/depth/size gates remain open.
Multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal qualification and newer Apple source integration remain open. No throughput gain or overall completion is claimed.
